name: chat_resource
reportModel:
<#list data as item>

编号：${item.show_identifier!''}

标题：${item.title!''}

负责人 ${item.assignee_name!''}

<#if item.state_text??>
状态：${item.state_text!''}
</#if>
 
<#if item.priority_text??>
优先级：${item.priority_text!''}
</#if>

描述：${item.description!''}

<#assign comments = api.invoke("/ideas/"+item.id+"/comments/fetch_default",'{"n_owner_type_eq":"IDEA","n_principal_id_eq":"'+item.id+'","page":0,"size":1000}') >
<#if comments?has_content>
评论
	<#list comments as comment>
	${comment.create_man!""}于${comment.create_time!""}发表
		<#if comment.pcontent??>
		> ${comment.pcontent}
		</#if>
		${utils.html2md(comment.content!"")}
	</#list>
</#if>

</#list>
